Module isolation - Each module is a separate import.
Inference can't reach into code-assistant's scope to add methods.
Cross-context calls - Business module might be in extension-page, inference in service-worker.
Direct method calls won't route correctly.
Runtime registration pattern - Actions are registered as `module.
action` pairs, not injected functions.
